resources.string: Photograph a specific item, like your medication bottle. Only that item, with its label, stops the alarm.
Show every one of these items, in any order, to stop the alarm.
Choose or add at least one item before saving this alarm.

Hold the item so its label fills the white square. Tap Record and slowly turn the item for 5 seconds, showing every side you might show when the alarm rings. You can also add single photos. The background is ignored.
Recording… keep turning the item slowly.
No usable frames: keep the label inside the square, in good light, and move slowly.
That photo was blurry. Hold still and try again.
Not enough printed detail. Turn the label towards the camera and fill the square.
%1$d photo(s) didn\'t look like the same item and were removed. Retake them showing the same label.
Test it: show the item to the camera like you will when the alarm rings.
The item could not be saved.
The camera could not start. Close this screen and try again.
%1$d alarm(s) use this item. It will be removed from them; an alarm left with no items will switch to the stop button.
